name: comp-511

frames.best_why: Calendar open with 19 circled and the button already reading November 19th, 2026.

tagline: Date button that drops open a single-month calendar.
summary: A field labelled Date picker: a dark outlined button reading Pick a date beside a calendar icon. Pressing it opens a floating month calendar, and choosing a day rewrites the button with a full date.
appearance: A small label sits above a full-width outlined button with grey placeholder text on the left and a calendar glyph on the right. Opened, a rounded panel below shows a month name between arrows, weekday initials and six rows of day numbers.
behaviour: Clicking the button fades the calendar in under it; hovering a day leaves a soft disc and clicking one circles it white while the button text becomes something like November 19th, 2026. The panel stays open after a pick.
demo_content: November 2026 with 19 chosen; caption reads "Built with React DayPicker".
search_phrases: date picker button that opens a calendar
single date field with popup calendar
choose one day from a floating month
form input for picking a day
popup calendar next to a button
dropdown month view for one date
click a button then choose a day
use_when: A form needs one date and the calendar should stay hidden until the field is pressed.
avoid_when: Only one month is offered at a time, so a date far from the current month takes several arrow clicks.
customise: The label, placeholder, caption and date format are written in the file; button width and popover alignment are fixed in the source as well.
weight_why: One button and a month calendar drawn only while the popover is open.

a11y.note: The trigger has a linked label and a visible focus outline; the chosen date is only carried as plain button text.

issues: The open popover covers its own caption line in the opening frames.
Only one month can be reached at a time.
The caption credits the calendar library instead of the control.
polish_why: Clean labelled trigger and a tidy calendar; the panel overlapping its caption is the only blemish.
title: Single Date Popover Picker
